short_description: Keep home maintenance, repairs, appliances and expenses together. Your home records stay on your device.
long_description:
Give your home records a place of their own. Plan recurring maintenance, track repairs, keep appliance details and warranty dates, save contractor contacts and link documents. No Fixavora account is required.

Start free with one active property and up to 15 active maintenance tasks. An optional one-time Amazon purchase unlocks more properties, warranties, contractors, expenses, report exports and encrypted record backups. There is no subscription. The Amazon purchase screen shows your local price.

The on-device assistant prepares task drafts for you to review before saving. Use typing on every device. Speech input and spoken feedback require compatible installed speech engines and voices. Fixavora does not retain audio.

Home records work offline. Purchases and receipt verification need an internet connection. Reminders can be delayed by device power settings. External document providers may need a connection. Encrypted backups contain records and history. External documents, photos and their attachment links are not included; keep separate copies and relink them after restoring.

Fixavora helps you organise information. It does not inspect your home or replace a qualified professional.
